items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine, Mrs. "Papa Jack" Laine and Johnny Wiggs Interview, 1959-02-27
items.q: You told me once that George Lewis and Paul Barber and I believe you said.

ctx.x: You told me once that George Lewis and Paul Barber and I believe you said.

items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine and Mrs. "Papa Jack" Laine Interview, 1960-05-23
items.q: I don't know, but that's when I discovered this Paul Barbario.

ctx.x: They both played for the Jazz at their auditorium one night. What's that other name of that other colored band?
I don't know, but that's when I discovered this Paul Barbario. I had his picture too.
I think you told me once before when we talked to you, it was George Lewis, I believe you said. Lewis, I believe Lewis, don't you know Lewis?
